subject.why: Clear, recognisable straw hat complete with wide brim, rounded crown, and red band.

category.why: Object rests on a flat light blue surface with a matching blue gradient wall.

clean.why: Free of text, UI, borders, and characters.

framing.why: Centered placement with balanced margins on all sides.

colour.why: Vibrant yellow and red subject contrasting cleanly with the blue background.

detail.why: The weave is broken into dozens of small pillow-like segments rather than broad, continuous bands.

style.why: Chunky 3D volumes and smooth satin shading align with reference quality.

bg_colour.why: background is blue (97% of the background); planned blue

fix: Simplify the weave texture into longer, continuous smooth bands instead of numerous small segmented blocks.
